description: Tamil Nadu AI Healthcare: The Tamil Nadu government is set to pilot AI-enabled diagnostic tools in hospitals to improve disease detection and patient care, focusing on tuberculosis, cataracts, and cancers. This initiative aims to modernize healthcare across the state.
body_lead: Tamil Nadu to pilot AI-powered disease diagnosis in government hospitals The pilot involves AI-enabled X-ray systems that use deep learning algorithms to identify patterns and anomalies in chest scans indicative of TB. Building on the success of artificial intelligence (AI) in detecting Covid-19 through chest scans, the Tamil Nadu government is set to launch a pilot project to test AI’s effectiveness in diagnosing tuberculosis, cataracts, cancers and other diseases at Royapettah Government Hospital and Periyar Nagar Government Hospital.
